# Tan Luc

> Tan Luc is a software engineer based in Vietnam. This portfolio presents frontend and full-stack engineering work, experience, and personal projects.

Request the homepage with `Accept: text/markdown` for a Markdown overview; use `Accept: text/html` for the interactive website. Follow the links below for detailed evidence. This website is an informational portfolio; contact details are on the About page and resume.

## When to use this

- [Engineering experience](https://tanluc.dev/about/): Use when evaluating Tan Luc for React, Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, or full-stack work; consult the experience and technology sections.
- [AI workflow interfaces](https://tanluc.dev/work/dynamic-model/): Use when looking for examples of schema-driven model configuration, canvas editors, validation, and workflow execution interfaces.
- [Independent products](https://tanluc.dev/work/): Use when assessing end-to-end product delivery through Cafe Maps and Grateful Forum, or healthcare licensing and billing work through MedicHIMS.
- [Resume and contact](https://tanluc.dev/documents/nguyen-tan-luc-cv.pdf): Use when a user asks for Tan Luc's professional background or contact information. Confirm details here before drafting outreach; sending messages requires the user's authorization.
